description: Search Pinterest by keyword. Returns Pins (default), Boards (user-curated collections of Pins), or Users, depending on the type parameter. Also returns related_queries: the query-refinement suggestions Pinterest shows at the top of the results page. Requires a logged-in browser session.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: What to search: pin (individual Pins, i.e. image/video posts, default) | board (Boards — user-curated collections that group Pins by theme) | user (Pinterest users/creators).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-100, default 20). Results lazy-load on scroll; the command scrolls until the limit is reached or results are exhausted (then returns fewer with partial=true).
